surface_verification.justification: CI-workflow gate logic (GitHub Actions YAML + pure Python decision functions); no startable UI/web/API surface exists to drive -- behavior is covered by the pure-function unit tests (test_pr_review_gate_verdict.py, test_review_record_tier.py, test_pr_review_generated_skip_review.py) and workflow-shape snapshot tests, per the acceptance criteria in the iterate spec.

behaviors.behavior: an all-generated changed-path list posts PR Review=success with a self-explaining description (acceptance 1)
one sensitive path in the mix still blocks, even when every other path is generated (acceptance 2)
a model/API failure on an all-generated PR still fails -- the carve-out never becomes a catch-all (acceptance 3)
a failed waiver-consumption on an all-generated + waived PR still fails, never masked by the carve-out (code-review finding)
an all-generated + waived + waiver-OK PR posts the generated reason, not the waiver's tier reason (external-review finding)
the three agent-instruction docs (build_dashboard.md, session_handoff.md, triage_inbox.md) are NOT safe to skip review, though still is_generated_path (doubt-review finding)
an off-canonical path with a generated basename is NOT safe to skip review -- basename matches anchor to their canonical path (doubt-review finding)
the classifier keeps canonical generated prefixes/basenames/review-evidence skip-safe (no regression)
classify_generated_only: all-generated changed paths, one sensitive path, one reviewable path, empty/truncated lists, CLI output wiring
the review-run step's if: still asserts all three conditions (workflow_run success, needs_review, all_generated != true), not only the new one (external-review finding)

under set -e, the gate-decision script call is guarded (|| gate_out="") so a crash still reaches the existing empty-state failure fallback instead of aborting the step silently (external-review finding, empirically verified)
stage1/tier failure and an ordinary reviewed PR's verdicts are unaffected by the new carve-out (non-regression)
end-to-end GitHub Actions execution of the two-stage workflow_run chain against a real fork PR
behaviors.reason: GitHub Actions workflow_run chaining cannot be exercised locally; mitigated by the workflow-shape snapshot tests plus the fully-tested pure decision function (decide_gate) the workflow now delegates to.
